relations.myth: Emergence and commissioning of the divine fathers
relations.note: Ñamandu brings Karai into divine consciousness and commissions him over sacred fire.
Karai Chy Ete is Karai's divine counterpart and co-parent of human name-souls.
Karai makes or recognizes Karai Chy Ete as divine before his heart.
This collective comprises Karai's heavenly offspring, guardians and masters of sacred flame.

relations.myth: Commissioning in the First Earth discourse
relations.note: Karai receives the sacred fires while Jakaira receives the vivifying mist.
Karai brings sacred heat to human hearts while Tupã provides cooling balance.

relations.other: the collective True Fathers and Mothers of the word-souls
relations.myth: Liturgical invocation of the divine rows
relations.note: Karai and his counterpart are invoked alongside the other divine parents.

relations.myth: Traditions concerning the master of peccaries
relations.note: A younger or lesser Karai belongs to Karai's domain, but their precise relation is uncertain.
